title: fix(tui): discard stale weather fetches on relaunch with a per-launch epoch
claim: Only the latest weather load (relaunch or r refresh) may settle the ambient weather widget; an older fetch settling later must not overwrite it with a stale report or a stale error.

evidence.red: Two new Open-Meteo relaunch-race tests on unpatched main both FAIL: (1) toMatchObject diff '- "area": "Rome, Italy" / + "area": "Paris, France"' under location 'Rome' (stale success clobbers). (2) '- "kind": "ready" ... / + "kind": "error"' (stale rejection flips the ready card).
evidence.negative_control: Guard 'if (epoch === loadEpoch)' -> 'if (true)': both new tests fail again; restored -> green.
evidence.adjacent: vitest userWidgets/weatherApp/widgetGridComponent/widgetSdk: 4 files / 23 tests pass. npm run typecheck clean; eslint + prettier clean.
evidence.source: main ui-tui/src/sdk/apps/weather.tsx:229-238 load() fires fetchReport() fire-and-forget; host.tsx:84-102 updateWidget matches by appId only, so it cannot tell launches apart.

upstream_overlap: No PR/issue for this race (gh search 'weather widget stale', 'weather relaunch', 'weather.tsx'; cached title scan).
